acceptedRuntime.notes: 91bfa59a is the accepted fork head containing the iris_agent#41 production-lock fix chain. Its tree is the immutable identity consumers must verify (git rev-parse 91bfa59a^{tree}). The previously pinned seam commit e18f7dd and the prior fork main fa7aba0a share the tree 1b43382f...; the fix chain changes the manifest tree, so the accepted identity now covers the fixed lock surface itself. acceptedRuntime is the single authoritative identity for the Pi runtime iris_agent is allowed to consume; floating main is never an accepted identity.
